jsonld_raw.name: FIELDS AT NIGHTFALL INTENSE PARFUM 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
FIELDS AT NIGHTFALL INTENSE PARFUM 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ.). The most intense and profound interpretation of Fields at Nightfall. Coconut water provides a soft freshness that blends with the floral sensuality of jasmine sambac. Bourbon vanilla intensifies the warm, creamy base, creating a rich and sophisticated trail that lingers on the skin.

Woody amber | Intense, warm, and seductive.
